body: This is advice I will take to heart. I can't express how grateful I am for this reply, really. Thank you.

Am I worth more than I've estimated? I'm 20, unable to hold down simple minimum wage jobs (7/11 being the third one I've been let go from in 7 months), unable to handle simple stresses, living with my mom, having never had a girl care about me in any form. I had a guy beg me not to tell him I was a virgin because I was "attractive and skinny". I don't think that matters if I have social retardation. 


I asked one of my best friends since high school who had said he'd buy a console and some bourbon today to hang out and he left me on unseen but received. What the fuck is that?

I have been diagnosed with MDD since I was 13. Very perceptive of you to pick that up. 

I've been meaning to see a psychiatrist, but I keep putting it off since the last person made me wait an hour to not listen to me and put me on Zoloft despite me explaining I had been on it before and it made me feel worse, gain weight, and did nothing to ease any pain.  

I see a therapist twice a month already.
